vendor/qrcode.js — QR code encoder used by "Add a phone" (runs in the browser, offline)

Upstream: QRCode.js by davidshimjs (https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs),
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2012 davidshimjs. It wraps "QRCode for JavaScript"
by Kazuhiko Arase (http://www.d-project.com/), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2009
Kazuhiko Arase.

Copy taken from the Firefox 128 ESR source tree
(testing/web-platform/tests/tools/wave/www/lib/davidshimjs/qrcode.js,
sha256 6f0987fcdd434a61889ac4ddf0b68ab77b69a4bd159f25337f214f509d133f6a).

Local change (2026-11-25, nebula app): the last lines export QRCode.Model and
QRCode.typeNumberFor so the app can draw its own SVG, plus a CommonJS export
for tests. Nothing else changed. Checked against node-qrcode 1.5.4 (MIT):
for 12 payload lengths (22 to 2900 characters, ECC level L) every module
matrix is identical for the same version and mask.
